items.name: Enhanced Oil Recovery
items.description: Every pumpjack lifts +1 barrel at dawn.
items.flavor: Waterflood the pattern and the old wells wake up.

items.name: Hardbanding
items.description: Blast walls have 50% more integrity.
items.flavor: A tungsten carbide band where the wear happens.

items.name: Top Drive
items.description: Your hero attacks 20% faster.
items.flavor: No more kelly. Rotate from the top, connect faster.

items.name: Mud Motor
items.description: Your hero moves 15% faster.
items.flavor: Let the mud do the turning.

items.name: Hazard Pay
items.description: All your units deal 20% more damage.
items.flavor: Pay them for the night shift and they fight like it.

items.name: Monkeyboard Marksmen
items.description: Derrick towers reach 20% further.
items.flavor: The derrickman sees the whole pad from up there.

items.name: Safety Stand-Down
items.description: Units have 25% more health.
items.flavor: Everybody stops work, everybody goes home safe.

items.name: Royalty Interest
items.description: At dawn, earn 10% interest on unspent barrels (up to +5).
items.flavor: The mineral owner always gets paid first.

items.name: Crew Change
items.description: Fallen units are replaced 50% faster during the night.
items.flavor: The helicopter is already on its way.

items.name: Rate of Penetration
items.description: Your hero deals 20% more damage.
items.flavor: Feet per hour is the only metric that matters.

items.name: Modular Rig-Up
items.description: Derrick tower upgrades are no longer limited by the Main Rig tier, and towers cost 1 barrel less to build. Pairs well with Mast Raise for cheap max-level towers.
items.flavor: Skid it in, pin it, raise it. No crane needed.

items.name: Resilient Pumpjacks
items.description: Pumpjacks have double integrity and still pay at dawn after they are knocked out and rebuilt. Pairs with Fortified Pumpjacks for a risk-free economy that also shoots back.
items.flavor: Stroke, stroke, stroke. Even after the storm.

items.name: Blowout Preventer
items.description: Once per night, when the Main Rig drops below 50% integrity, the rams close: it takes no damage for 5 seconds.
items.flavor: Annular, pipe rams, blind shear rams. Close them all.

items.name: Cathodic Protection
items.description: All your buildings slowly repair themselves during the night (2 integrity per second).
items.flavor: A little sacrificial zinc keeps the steel alive.

items.name: Shaped-Charge Walls
items.description: When a blast wall is breached it detonates, dealing 60 damage around it. Elite enemies usually shrug it off, so it's best against swarms.
items.flavor: If they want through, they can have all of it at once.

items.name: Fortified Pumpjacks
items.description: Pumpjacks get a nail gun that fires at nearby enemies for 8 damage. Turns your oil field into a second wall of towers.
items.flavor: Somebody bolted a nail gun to the walking beam.

items.name: Hot Tapping
items.description: Your hero's hits set enemies on fire (4 damage per second for 3 seconds).
items.flavor: Cutting into a live line. Sparks included.

items.name: Downhole Telemetry
items.description: Your hero has a 15% chance to land a critical hit for double damage.
items.flavor: Real-time data from the bit. You know exactly where to hit.

items.name: Hydraulic Jars
items.description: Your hero's hits knock enemies back 60% further and deal 10% more damage.
items.flavor: Cock it, fire it, and the fish comes free.

items.name: Double Crew
items.description: Every unit building fields one extra unit.
items.flavor: Two crews, twelve-hour tours, round the clock.

items.name: Rope Access Team
items.description: Your units reach 25% further.
items.flavor: Certified to hang off the side of anything.

items.name: Flare Igniters
items.description: Derrick towers deal 25% more damage and set targets on fire.
items.flavor: Pilot lit. Everything downwind is now a flare.

items.name: Joint Venture
items.description: Crew camps, perforation ranges and the company man's office, and their upgrades, cost 20% less.
items.flavor: Share the risk, share the rigs.

items.name: Kick Detection
items.description: See where tonight's wave will come from during the day. Enemies are slowed by 40% for the first 6 seconds of each night.
items.flavor: Pit gain, flow increase. Shut it in early.

items.name: Fishing Job
items.description: When your hero falls, they are back on the rig floor 50% faster.
items.flavor: Overshot on, latch, pull. We got him.

items.name: Mast Raise
items.description: Main Rig upgrades cost 30% less, and each Rig tier adds +1 barrel at dawn.
items.flavor: Raise the mast once and do it right.

items.name: H2S Scrubbers
items.description: Your hero, units and buildings take 30% less damage from flying enemies.
items.flavor: Sweeten the gas before it gets to anyone.

items.name: Flare Gas Recovery
items.description: Every enemy kill has an 8% chance to drop a barrel.
items.flavor: Stop burning money. Capture it.

items.name: Gusher
items.description: All income at dawn is increased by 30%.
items.flavor: Black gold, raining from the crown block.

items.name: Deluge System
items.description: Your buildings take 25% less damage.
items.flavor: Every nozzle on the platform opens at once.

items.name: Swivel Joint
items.description: Your class ability recharges 25% faster.
items.flavor: Keeps the mud flowing while everything turns.

items.name: Second Barrier
items.description: The Main Rig has 40% more integrity.
items.flavor: Two independent barriers, always. That's the rule.

items.name: Kelly Drive
items.description: Your hero deals 12% more damage and attacks 12% faster.
items.flavor: Old school, square and reliable.

items.name: Overbalanced Mud
items.description: Enemies hit by your hero are slowed by 25% for 2 seconds.
items.flavor: A little heavier than the formation. Nothing moves.

items.name: Spot Price Spike
items.description: Your first purchase each day costs 2 fewer barrels.
items.flavor: Sell high, build cheap.

items.name: Leading Hand
items.description: Your Follow command reaches 60% further and your units move 15% faster.
items.flavor: One radio, one voice, one crew.

items.name: Crown Saver
items.description: Derrick towers attack 40% faster.
items.flavor: The block stops itself. The gunners never do.

items.name: Black Gold Rush
items.description: Tank batteries pay +2 barrels and pumpjacks +1 barrel at dawn.
items.flavor: The boomtown has arrived.

items.name: Relief Well
items.description: Once per run, when the Main Rig would fall, it survives with 30% integrity instead.
items.flavor: Drilled on day one, just in case.

items.name: Wildcatter's Luck
items.description: The reward wheel favours rarer segments, and every night survived gives +2 core samples.
items.flavor: Drill where nobody else would. Sometimes it pays.
